title: Competencia de Conduccion (Costa Rica)
description: Credencial de maestria que demuestra competencia continua para conducir (teoria y practica). Sujeta a modelo de decaimiento — la competencia se degrada con el tiempo y requiere renovacion periodica.

competencyLevel.description: Current mastery tier based on accumulated assessments

examsPassed.description: Total number of exams passed (theory + practical)

masteryScore.description: Composite mastery score (0-100) factoring in decay

categories.description: License categories covered by this competency (e.g. B, B1, C1)

lastAssessedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent competency assessment

decayRate.description: Decay rate tier (e.g. standard, accelerated, frozen)

renewalDue.description: Date by which renewal assessment must be completed
